## Description

Threads by category with owner and SLA; filters (Open, …). AI drafts a reply (dashed "AI draft") that staff edit/approve before sending; clinical questions are flagged "Attention · clinical question. Routed to Dr. … Staff can acknowledge but only a clinician can give medical advice." Message bodies encrypted at rest.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** No AI-drafted reply is sent without explicit staff approval.
- [ ] **AC2.** Clinical questions are routed to the clinician; non-clinicians cannot send clinical advice (role check on send for flagged threads).
- [ ] **AC3.** SLA breach shows on the thread and in notifications.
- [ ] **AC4.** Message content never appears in push notifications or logs.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
